'''Criik''' is a [[Keshiri language|Keshiri]] word used by the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==Usage==
Sith apprentice [[Vestara Khai]] uttered this word when [[Gavar Khai|her wounded father]] regained consciousness.
